teach.heading: Partitioning
teach.body: Partitioning means splitting a number into parts. We have already split numbers into hundreds, tens and ones. 346 = 300 + 40 + 6.

teach.heading: Flexible partitioning
teach.body: A number can be split in other ways too. 346 = 200 + 140 + 6 because 1 hundred has been regrouped as 10 tens. It also equals 300 + 30 + 16 because 1 ten has been regrouped as 10 ones. The total stays the same.

teach.heading: Why it matters
teach.body: Flexible partitioning is what we use when we add and subtract. In the next weeks you will use it to regroup when you subtract from numbers such as 302.

teach.heading: Checking your answer
teach.body: To check a partition, add the parts. If they make the number, the partition is right.

worked_examples.q: Show 352 as 2 hundreds and some tens and ones.
worked_examples.steps: Take one hundred from 3 hundreds. That leaves 2 hundreds and makes 10 more tens. 5 tens + 10 tens = 15 tens.

worked_examples.q: Show 421 as 4 hundreds, 1 ten and ___ ones.
worked_examples.steps: Take one ten from 2 tens. 1 ten is left. 10 ones plus 1 one is 11 ones.

guided_practice.hint: What is in the tens place?
You took 100 away so tens go up by 10.
You took one ten away. What does it become?

task.instructions: Part 1 is partitioning. Part 2 is a review of the week.
questions: 1. Write 458 in three different ways using hundreds, tens and ones.
3. Write 5 hundreds and 12 tens as a number.
4. Review: write 7 hundreds, 0 tens and 6 ones as a number, in expanded form and in words.
5. Review: order 685, 658, 865, 586 from smallest to largest.
6. Review: write 10 more, 10 less, 100 more and 100 less than 540.
7. Challenge: I am a number between 600 and 700. My ones digit is half my tens digit. My hundreds digit and ones digit add up to 8. What number am I?
answers: 7. 642: the tens digit 4 has a half of 2 in the ones place, and 6 + 2 = 8.

quiz.explain: The 5 is in the tens place, worth 50.

quiz.q: Which list is in ascending order?

quiz.explain: 1000 is 10 hundreds, so 100 less leaves 9 hundreds.
